title: Pyramids built during the Saharan Humid Period

tellings.quote: I think they were built by the civilization that lived in Egypt during a period known as the Saharan Humid Period, which is from 8,500 BC to around 5,300 BC.

plain: Egypt's pyramids were built by a civilisation that lived there during the Saharan Humid Period, which he dates from about 8,500 BC to around 5,300 BC, according to a researcher named Jeffrey Drum. Drum tells Michels this as his own view ("I think they were built by the civilization that lived in Egypt" in that period) and names no source. If true, the pyramids would be roughly 7,300 to 10,500 years old.
